title: Cymba soft-featured stone mannequin — reference v3
direction: Softer subtly masculine adult face, open stone eyes, calm pleasant neutral expression, broader simple pink-purple brain illumination, ivory head and neck only, upright neutral pose.
notes: Neural highlights are illustrative visual overlays, not validated anatomical maps.
Generated views can have small geometry and pathway differences; use the front portrait as the primary identity reference and reconcile views during modelling.
No live site or 3D model changed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Edit target: the supplied frontal ivory stone mannequin, a premium 3D modelling reference.
Make these three changes while preserving the neck-up composition, full crown, both complete ears, straight-ahead neutral upright head position, flat neck-only base, ivory honed stone, cool grey background and soft studio lighting.

1. Slightly LESS MASCULINE: soften the heavy brow ridge and square jaw, gently round the chin and cheek transitions. Keep a believable adult face with balanced, mildly androgynous features and a subtle masculine foundation. Make a modest refinement of this identity, not a different character, not an exaggerated feminine face. No hair or beard.
2. EYES OPEN and pleasant neutral expression: natural relaxed open eyes looking straight ahead, soft gaze, relaxed brow with no frown or central tension, relaxed closed lips with only the faintest pleasant lift at the corners. Calm and approachable, no broad smile, no teeth. Eyes are sculpted from the same ivory stone, with elegantly defined shallow irises and pupils using soft relief and shadow. No realistic wet eyeballs, no glowing eyes, no blank holes or uncanny stare.
3. MORE OF THE BRAIN ILLUMINATED, but SIMPLE: retain the restrained pink-purple ear and lateral-neck neural highlights. Extend illumination across a larger region inside the upper cranium, from above the brows through both sides and toward the crown. Suggest two softly luminous simplified cerebral hemispheres through very subtle subsurface translucency in the stone. Use a small number of elegant sweeping pink and violet pathways, around 8 to 12 broad smooth curves total, with only a few junctions and large calm spaces. A very faint diffuse pink-violet inner glow ties them together. This should read as a softly lit brain region rather than two narrow temple streaks. No detailed brain folds, no dense neuron branches, no intricate mesh or spaghetti, no circuit-board pattern, no lightning, no bright pinpoint dots. Intact smooth stone head silhouette, no cut-open skull, no lid or glass helmet; face remains solid opaque stone. Restrained elegant glow, no blown-out highlights.

Keep the overall sculpture simple, refined and professional, tactile matte ivory stone with restrained fine grain. Ears stay realistic and unobstructed for future earbuds. Head and neck only: no shoulders, clavicles, torso or pedestal. No accessories, earbuds, wires, text, labels or logos.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: consistent four-view 3D modelling reference sheet.
Input: the supplied ivory HEAD AND NECK sculpture is the exact identity, expression, geometry and illuminated pathway reference.

Create a square high-resolution 2x2 sheet of the SAME sculpture from four orthographic camera directions: top left FRONT, top right LEFT PROFILE with nose pointing right, bottom left RIGHT PROFILE with nose pointing left, bottom right REAR. All complete sculptures fit inside their quadrants with equal margins, same scale and eye-level camera height, aligned flat neck bases. Move the camera around the sculpture, do not tilt or turn the head relative to its neck.

Preserve the reference's gentler balanced subtly masculine adult face, softened jaw and brow, open sculpted stone eyes looking straight ahead, calm pleasant neutral mouth, no broad smile. Preserve the complete realistic ears, bald head, smooth subtly textured matte ivory stone, neutral upright pose, cylindrical neck cut flat above the shoulders. NO shoulders, collarbones, chest, torso, widened bust base or pedestal.

Preserve the simple pink-purple illuminated paths around the conchae and sides of the neck. The upper cranium shows a softly luminous simplified brain region through subtle stone translucency, with just a few graceful branching curves across both hemispheres, gently lit pink and violet. Continue these same sparse cranial paths coherently in the side and rear views, using broad curves and generous empty space. Never add intricate mesh, realistic brain folds, dense neural trees, or detailed glowing dots. The rear lower head and neck remain predominantly clean stone, with side pathways only; no central spinal vagus line. Face stays opaque ivory, eyes never glow, head silhouette intact, no glass helmet or cutaway.

Matching facial and ear identity across views is crucial. Uniform cool pale grey #f5f5f7 seamless studio background, gentle diffuse studio light, subtle contact shadows, sharp complete silhouettes. No text, captions, borders, panel dividers, logos, watermarks, jewelry, hair, earbuds or extra objects.
